text:
Predicates:
BritishSitcom(x) ::: x is a British Sitcom series.
Member(x, y) ::: x is a member of y.
Starring(x, y) ::: x stars in y.
Piloted(x, y, z) ::: x was piloted in month y on channel z.
WorkingTitle(x, y) ::: x is the working title of y.
ScriptEditor(x, y) ::: x is the script editor of y.
Premises:
BritishSitcom(badults) ∧ ∃y (Member(y, pappys) ∧ Starring(y, badults)) ::: Badults is a British Sitcom series starring members of Pappy's.
Piloted(badults, july, bbcThree) ::: Badults was piloted in July 2013 on BBC Three.
WorkingTitle(secretDudeSociety, badults) ::: The working title 'The Secret Dude Society' was used for Badults.
ScriptEditor(andrewCollins, badults) ::: Andrew Collins was the script editor for Badults.
Conclusion:
¬∃x ∃y ∃z (Member(x, pappys) ∧ Starring(x, y) ∧ Piloted(y, z, bbcTwo) ∨ Piloted(y, z, bbcThree)) ::: No members of Pappy's have starred in a show piloting on BBC Two or BBC Three.
